gloss_en: How can I make sure an IDS file is well formed before using it, and will bSI offer an online validator?
title_original: How to validate IDS files?
question_paraphrase: wants IDS files to be correctly formatted before validating IFC; vendors produce them differently; asks if an online IDS validator is planned
phrasing_notes: polite forum post, asks about official roadmap
answer_summary: bSI IDS Audit tool (open source) checks entity use per IFC version, pset names, cardinality; plain XML validators only check XSD; Solibri rejected a file mixing IFC2x3 and IFC4 scopes.

gloss_en: Can IDS check the bounds of an IfcPropertyBoundedValue such as People in Pset_SpaceThermalLoad?
title_original: Using IDS to Validate Property Attributes
question_paraphrase: asks if IDS can validate upper/lower bound of a bounded value property and how the XML looks
answer_summary: Closed as duplicate of an IDS GitHub discussion; no technical answer in thread.

gloss_en: Can IDS check that quantities exist, is the XML like for properties?
title_original: Validation of quantities using IDS
question_paraphrase: asks whether IDS can verify quantities exist in the model; user later found she used IfcQuantityLength instead of IfcLengthMeasure as data type
phrasing_notes: asks yes/no first, discovers own error later
answer_summary: Quantities use the property facet; dataType must be the measure type (IfcLengthMeasure), not the quantity class.

gloss_en: I want an IDS that requires PredefinedType on IfcCovering; my file gives Error 502 in the xbim checker.
title_original: Requiring the existence of Predefined Type
question_paraphrase: needs PredefinedType required to separate ceilings, flooring, insulation; had mvdXML rule in BIMQ; generated IDS fails with error 502
phrasing_notes: mentions competing tools, reports error code only
answer_summary: Error 502 means XML not well-formed (hidden char); inspect in Notepad++, use an authoring tool rather than hand-writing XML; check with IDS Audit tool.

gloss_en: Can I merge per-discipline IDS files to check a federated IFC?
title_original: IDS and Federated IFC file
question_paraphrase: railway station project, many authoring tools; asks how to combine IDS files for a federated model
answer_summary: Keep IDS per discipline or one master IDS with optional requirements; make applicability specific; no tool merges IDS, copy specifications manually.

gloss_en: My IDS with applicability on IFCELEMENT fails in Bonsai, how do I require a custom parameter on all elements?
title_original: Applicability for all Elements
question_paraphrase: assigned unique parameters in Revit; IDS applies to IFCELEMENT min/max 1; check fails
answer_summary: IfcElement is abstract and IDS ignores inheritance; list entities explicitly; workaround: Tag attribute with regex excluding type names.

gloss_en: IfcBeam and its IfcBeamType both have PredefinedType; can IDS catch that or am I misreading the spec?
title_original: The PredefinedType shall only be used...
question_paraphrase: spent hours on IDS files that were invalid or missed it; ReferenceView 1.2 file
answer_summary: File is invalid; IDS validates valid IFC; use Validation Service, rule OJT001 reported (also QTY001).

gloss_en: How does IDS relate to IDM and MVD?
title_original: What is the relationship between IDS and IDM or MVD?
question_paraphrase: asks difference between IDS, IDM and MVD
answer_summary: IDS for model/project requirements and validation; MVD for software certification subschemas; IDM for business use cases; IDS covers only alphanumeric part of LOIN.

gloss_en: How do I write IDS so a functional unit is either IfcSpatialZone OCCUPANCY or IfcSpace FUNCTIONALUNIT but not mixed?
title_original: IDS - Allowing two entities, but they have different PredefinedTypes
question_paraphrase: wants either option allowed but mixed combos blocked
answer_summary: Three specifications: min 1 of either, max 0 for IfcSpace OCCUPANCY, max 0 for IfcSpatialZone FUNCTIONALUNIT; USERDEFINED treated via ObjectType.

gloss_en: How do I specify two data types for a table property like SoundCurve in IDS?
title_original: Specifying data type for table value with multiple data types?
question_paraphrase: Pset_SoundGeneration SoundCurve is IfcPropertyTableValue with two measure types
answer_summary: Write two requirements (one per column type); Audit tool wrongly reports no allowed data types, raised as GitHub issue.

gloss_en: How do I get the whole list of IFC classes from bSDD for an IDS class picker?
title_original: Querry the whole list of IFC classes to bSDD for IDS writing
question_paraphrase: API returns only 1000 classes; search returns odd matches
answer_summary: Use DictionaryUris filter and offset/limit pagination (2163 IFC classes); property sets are not bSDD objects.

gloss_en: Is an old IFC file invalid if a derived unit like VOLUMETRICFLOWRATE has no unit defined?
title_original: What is the default for a derived unit that isn't set in the file?
question_paraphrase: file uses cubic metres and years; asks what unit applies
answer_summary: Community leans to: invalid, derived unit must be defined; Validation Service has no rule yet; rule proposed.

gloss_en: Are IfcGuids starting with k valid?
title_original: GUID valid/invalid
question_paraphrase: asks if GUID like k0el31... is allowed
answer_summary: Not valid: exceeds 128 bits; some tools still generate invalid GUIDs; fixed in IFC4.3.

gloss_en: Why uppercase instead of PascalCase for class names in IDS?
title_original: Uppercase instead of PascalCase in IDS?
question_paraphrase: asks reason for UPPERCASE class identifiers in the Candidate Standard
answer_summary: No replies in thread; also filed as IDS issue 132.

gloss_en: Which MIME type does an IDS file have?
title_original: What MIME tipe could be IDS?
question_paraphrase: asks whether IDS has its own MIME type or application/xml
answer_summary: Schema returns text/xml.

gloss_en: IFC opens in Revit fine but fails Schema validation on the bSI service, is the validator wrong?
title_original: Schema validation fails for IFC that opens fully in Revit
question_paraphrase: file opens with no warnings in Revit, fails validate.buildingsmart.org
answer_summary: Root cause: about 500-level deep boolean subtraction tree breaks derived IfcBooleanResult.Dim calculation; Autodesk said Revit files won't all pass yet.

gloss_en: Validator crashes with unsupported operand error on IfcSurfaceWeightsPositive though weights are positive
title_original: Validation error IfcSurfaceWeightsPositive
question_paraphrase: quotes rule text and instance of IfcRationalBSplineSurfaceWithKnots
answer_summary: Validator bug when checking weight array; reported to maintainers.

gloss_en: Validation Service error message is unclear on my bridge alignment file, what does it mean?
title_original: Error message is unclear
question_paraphrase: new error messages in VS 0.6.4, file attached, units conform to guide
phrasing_notes: asks what it means and how to fix
answer_summary: Units attribute must be derived, use * not $; reporter says docs do not explain 'formally derived' and message should be clearer.

gloss_en: Anyone else getting 502 when logging into the Validation Service today?
title_original: [ Service Unreachable? ]
question_paraphrase: 502 on login
answer_summary: Storage-layer fault on the server, fixed.

gloss_en: Doc notes on installing the validation service on Windows with git submodules and Docker
title_original: [Documentation] Installing the Validation Service on Windows
question_paraphrase: shares struggles with git submodules and docker as non-expert
answer_summary: Submodules ifc_gherkin_rules, store, ifc_validation_models must be initialised.

gloss_en: IFC opens normally in Revit but fails buildingSMART validation schema check
title_original: PR: IFC opens normally in Revit, but fails buildingSMART IFC Validation Service
question_paraphrase: reported to Revit IFC team
answer_summary: Autodesk: Revit files won't all pass current tests; this one is a validator issue.

gloss_en: IDS integer vs string value checks in ifctester give an odd 3/1 result matrix
title_original: ifctester ids simple value pset prop checks on integers and strings
question_paraphrase: 4-case matrix of model type vs python value type
answer_summary: Model type leads, IDS value coerced; outlier caused by Python API when passing int.

gloss_en: IDS applicability without minOccurs/maxOccurs is treated as required
title_original: ifctester: IDS applicability with no minOccurs/maxOccurs is treated as required
question_paraphrase: spec fails vs skipped changes compliance report
answer_summary: xs:occurs defaults to 1 so fallback unreachable; discussion on validity.

gloss_en: USERDEFINED in PredefinedType gives unpredictable IfcTester results
title_original: IfcTester. USERDEFINED in PredefinedType gives unpredictable results
question_paraphrase: no elements matched even valid ones; screenshots
answer_summary: Bug: restriction containing USERDEFINED short-circuited; fixed.

gloss_en: PredefinedType in Entity facet vs Attribute facet gives different check results
title_original: IfcTester. PredefinedType in different facets gives different check results
question_paraphrase: IfcColumnType typing IfcColumn gives different results across two specs
answer_summary: Entity facet bug fixed; attribute facet is literal.

gloss_en: Enforce PredefinedType values that mix standard and user-defined for IfcBridge
title_original: Enforcing required PredefinedType values when they are a mix of standard and user-defined
question_paraphrase: GIRDER or SLAB_BRIDGE requirement; tools force splitting into two specs
answer_summary: Attribute facet is literal; use USERDEFINED plus type or split specs.

gloss_en: How to give different requirements to objects in the same IFC entity?
title_original: How to differentiate requirements for objects within the same IFC entity?
question_paraphrase: different objects of same entity need different requirements
answer_summary: Use other facets (classification, property, attribute) to differentiate.

gloss_en: Allow multiple specifications containers in one IDS for grouping by discipline or phase
title_original: Support multiple specifications containers within a single IDS document
question_paraphrase: group requirements by discipline, phase, milestone
answer_summary: Open proposal.

gloss_en: A casual explanation of IDS: rules for checking IFC data, eight rule patterns, six facets
title_original: Information Delivery Specification (IDS) をゆるく説明する
question_paraphrase: explains IDS 1.0 as rule format; needs separate software to check
answer_summary: IDS defines rules not checks; use IfcTester; six facets; patterns of required/prohibited/conditional.

gloss_en: What IDS can do for the client: automate checking of IFC against requirements, limits
title_original: IFCデータを正しく運用する為のIDSの威力とは？
question_paraphrase: IDS as client weapon to replace Excel/PDF requirements, auto-check IFC
answer_summary: IDS cannot check geometry/clash; needs IFC knowledge; PartOf facet keeps IFC structured.

gloss_en: LongName, Status etc give positive false audit?
title_original: LongName, Status etc give positive false audit?
question_paraphrase: audit passes attributes that should not be allowed
answer_summary: Closed issue.

gloss_en: Audit error: invalid base type for Ifc4x3, no valid base type exists on value element
title_original: Invalid base type for Ifc4x3; no valid base type exists on value element
question_paraphrase: title only
answer_summary: Closed.

gloss_en: IfcCurveStyle WR11 check compares against 'bylayer' instead of 'by layer'
title_original: IfcCurveStyle WR11 check compares against 'bylayer' instead of 'by layer'
question_paraphrase: rule text mismatch
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: Uppercase FALSE boolean in IDS read as True so requirement passes wrongly
title_original: ifctester: IDS-valid uppercase boolean FALSE is read as True
question_paraphrase: title only
answer_summary: Closed.

gloss_en: Run schema validation and list the top error types
prompt: run the model thru schema validation, give me top 10 error types w/ counts
expected_behavior: Run IFC schema/EXPRESS rule validation, group errors by rule/type, report counts and example entity ids.

gloss_en: Check model against my IDS and show failing elements
prompt: check this ifc against the attached ids, which specs fail and which elements?
expected_behavior: Load IDS, run each specification, report pass/fail per spec with failing element GUIDs and reasons.

gloss_en: Write an IDS requiring FireRating on walls
prompt: make an ids: all IfcWall must have Pset_WallCommon.FireRating, not empty
expected_behavior: Create IDS XML with entity IfcWall applicability and property requirement with non-empty value; validate it.

gloss_en: Every element must have a Tag param
prompt: need ids so every element has a custom param Tag filled. IfcElement didnt work
expected_behavior: Explain IfcElement is abstract; enumerate concrete subclasses; exclude types; build and run the IDS.

gloss_en: Find elements with duplicate GlobalIds
prompt: it says guid error, find dup or invalid GlobalIds in model
expected_behavior: Scan GlobalIds for duplicates and invalid base64/length, list entities.

gloss_en: Check PredefinedType present on all IfcCovering
prompt: do all IfcCovering have PredefinedType set? list those with NOTDEFINED or empty
expected_behavior: Query IfcCovering, report PredefinedType missing/NOTDEFINED, offer IDS.

gloss_en: Beam vs type PredefinedType duplicates
prompt: any IfcBeam where PredefinedType is set while its type also has one?
expected_behavior: Compare occurrence and type PredefinedType, list conflicting beams, note rule OJT001.

gloss_en: Quantities exist check
prompt: check every slab has Qto_SlabBaseQuantities NetVolume > 0
expected_behavior: Check quantity sets on slabs, report missing or non-positive.

gloss_en: My IDS spec skipped instead of failing
prompt: ids shows spec as skipped not failed when no elements match, how make it fail?
expected_behavior: Explain applicability minOccurs/maxOccurs and how to require at least one match.

gloss_en: IDS vs mvdXML
prompt: whats the diff btw IDS and mvd, which do I use to check my model
expected_behavior: Explain IDS vs MVD vs IDM and recommend IDS for requirement checks.

gloss_en: Derived units defined?
prompt: do the volumetric flow props have derived units defined in this file?
expected_behavior: Find properties with derived measure types and check IfcUnitAssignment for corresponding derived units.

gloss_en: Merge IDS per discipline
prompt: combine arch and struct ids into one and run on federated model, report by discipline
expected_behavior: Merge specification lists, run, group results per discipline.

gloss_en: Why does bSI validator fail
prompt: validate.buildingsmart.org says fail but Revit opens it, which rules fail
expected_behavior: Run local validation, list failing rules and explain likely causes such as deep boolean trees.

gloss_en: Audit my IDS
prompt: audit this ids file for errors before i send it to the contractor
expected_behavior: Validate XSD and semantic rules (entity per version, pset names), report issues.

gloss_en: Check spatial containment
prompt: list elements not contained in any storey
expected_behavior: Find IfcElements without spatial containment, report counts by class.

gloss_en: Classification check
prompt: check all elements have Uniclass classification reference
expected_behavior: Check classification facet, report elements lacking references.

gloss_en: USERDEFINED types lacking user string
prompt: find types with USERDEFINED but empty ObjectType/ElementType
expected_behavior: Check USERDEFINED types lacking user-defined type string.
